entities.summary: Etteilla, the pseudonym of Jean-Baptiste Alliette, was a French occultist and tarot-researcher who, from 1783 to 1785, developed an interpretation concept for the tarot cards and made a significant contribution to the esoteric development of the tarot cards to a wide audience. Etteilla is widely regarded as the first professional tarot occultist known to history who made his living by card divination. Etteilla's influence can be seen in the work of French divination professional Marie Anne Lenormand. Etteilla's work also contributed to the popularization of tarot cards in Europe during the late 18th century. Etteilla's tarot card interpretations have been passed down through generations and continue to be studied and used by tarot enthusiasts and professionals alike. Etteilla's work on tarot cards also intersected with the broader cultural and intellectual currents of 18th-century France, including the rise of occultism and the emergence of new forms of divination.
